query: SELECT task.proposal,task.run_scopes FROM tasks task JOIN shop_environments e ON e.tenant=task.tenant WHERE task.tenant=$1 AND task.id=$2 AND task.run_actor=$3 AND task.applied AND task.run_state='ready' AND task.run_request ? 'execution' AND (e.preview_owner IS NULL OR (e.preview_owner=$3 AND e.preview_until>now()))
